meta.title: Choosing Modify Counter Offer changes the banner and exposes an editable field
gaps: The exact original and modified counter-offer banner content cannot be targeted by a dedicated domain assertion because the banner's label is not specified in the catalog.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The exact original and modified counter-offer banner content cannot be targeted by a dedicated domain assertion because the banner's label is not specified in the catalog.

steps.note: Open the prepared vendor session containing the pending counter offer.
Record the original counter-offer banner text before changing the response mode.
Open the vendor's decline response options.
Check that the counter-offer banner content changed after selecting modification.
Verify that an editable value field is available for the modified bid.
Verify that the vendor can submit the modified value.
